name: Esper
description: The Alaran shard where vedalken make up a large majority of the sentient population and lead magical advancement and the use of etherium.

description_citations.text: "Vedalken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sharuum dreams of sleeping to wake to a polished vision.
timeline.quote: Soon I will sleep, eyes closing to a world tarnished with flesh, and then wake to a polished vision.

citation.text: Scourglass (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lodus declares all life from tower to sea must be touched by etherium.
timeline.quote: From the highest towers to the deepest sea, all life must be touched by etherium.

citation.text: Steelclad Serpent (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rogue mechanists build unauthorized golems to threaten the sphinxes' hegemony; mindlock orbs stop them.
timeline.quote: Rogue mechanists once rummaged through the wastes of the Tidehollow

citation.text: Mindlock Orb (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xorin says his creature is free because he has told it what to do.
timeline.quote: It's free to do whatever it wants.

citation.text: Gather Specimens (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Revealing the truth only deepens Tezzeret's curiosity for the secrets still buried.
timeline.quote: Revealing the truth only deepened Tezzeret's curiosity for the secrets still buried.

citation.text: Brilliant Ultimatum (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ennor tells a victim thoughts are commodities.
timeline.quote: Thoughts are commodities.

citation.text: Esper Charm (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says Esper can be appreciated only from a distance.
timeline.quote: Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance.

citation.text: Tower Gargoyle (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crucius and the Ethersworn perfect their designs on drakes before infusing the first humanoid with etherium.
timeline.quote: spent years perfecting their designs on drakes before infusing the first humanoid.

citation.text: "Drake", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Ethersworn contact Vronos, who agrees to planeswalk in a controlled setting in exchange for knowledge.
timeline.quote: In exchange for knowledge, Vronos agreed to planeswalk in a controlled setting for the Ethersworn for a while.

citation.text: "Esper", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Etherium is said to have been created by the sphinx Crucius.
timeline.quote: Said to have been first created by the sphinx Crucius

citation.text: "Etherium". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals that the Codex Etherium is a fraud.
timeline.quote: it was revealed by Tezzeret that the Codex was a fraud

citation.text: "Etherium", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret apprentices to an artificer and later joins the Mechanists' Guild.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret apprenticed to an artificer immediately after leaving the cesspools of the Tidehollow

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Education". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At 19 Tezzeret replaces his right arm with solid etherium.
timeline.quote: At the age of 19, Tezzeret performed the ritual that severed his right arm and replaced it with a solid etherium arm

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Education". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guildmasters elevate Tezzeret to master status and he goes to the Academy of the Seekers.
timeline.quote: the guildmasters immediately elevated him to master status

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Education". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Learning he is to be expelled from the Academy, Tezzeret murders Headmaster Pannet.
timeline.quote: To cover his expulsion, he murdered Pannet and continued his training unabated

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Seekers' Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret breaks into the vault, finds the Codex Etherium a fraud, is beaten and his spark ignites.
timeline.quote: accidentally triggering his spark in the act

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Seekers' Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret massacres the Seekers on Esper, sparing only Silas Renn who was absent.
timeline.quote: he murdered the entire sect, eliminating the new Hieresiarch and the whole Arcane Council

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Seekers' Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Shards of Alara realigned, some vedalken migrated from Esper to Naya.
timeline.quote: some migrated to Naya after the Shards of Alara realigned

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Ethersworn are running out of etherium and must reclaim it from dead creatures, putting Esper in an etherium crisis.
timeline.quote: In essence, Esper is undergoing an etherium crisis.

citation.text: "Perfection through Etherium". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Ethersworn blame Crucius for aether-liches, and he disappears as an enemy of the plane.
timeline.quote: The Ethersworn blamed Crucius for etherium abominations called aether-liches

citation.text: "Perfection through Etherium". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bant's Blessed face Esper's metallic horrors and Naya's encroaching jungle, and the knight-captains find their ceremonial combat naive as massed armies fight.
timeline.quote: The angels seem powerless to enforce Bant's cherished law, and soldiers fall by the hundreds.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Esper's sphinxes decide war is the only recourse after their etherium gifts are spurned, and Esper mages go hunting carmot.
timeline.quote: The sphinxes decide that war is the only recourse

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis's demons and undead swarm across the borders to feed on the life essence of the neighboring shards.
timeline.quote: the demons and undead horrors swarm into the adjacent borderlands like a plague, gorging on all the life essence they encounter.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Esper thieves find it easy to explore the ruins of Grixis.
timeline.quote: thieves from Esper found it surprisingly easy to explore the ruins of Grixis.

citation.text: Vectis Agents (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Seekers of Carmot search the unknown lands for the red stone that could reforge Esper.
timeline.quote: The Seekers of Carmot searched across the unknown lands

citation.text: Vedalken Outlander (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aven scouts locate the Reliquary Tower in Esper and the Knights of the Reliquary set off on a crusade to recover their treasures.
timeline.quote: the Knights of the Reliquary set off on a righteous crusade to recover their lost treasures.

citation.text: Reliquary Tower (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Conflux, red and green mana flood Esper and its hegemony begins to fall apart.
timeline.quote: When the Conflux happened, red and green mana flooded into Esper.

citation.text: "Esper", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Esper's borders merge with Bant and Grixis into the new Alara.
timeline.quote: Esper's borders continued to smash into Bant and Grixis until it became part of the new Alara.

citation.text: "Esper", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dragons regularly bombard Esper's fortified cities.
timeline.quote: none more so than the dragons, who regularly bombard the fortified cities of Esper.

citation.text: "Esper", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret and Nicol Bolas fight over mining rights on an unnamed plane.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret and Nicol Bolas fought over mining rights on an unnamed plane

citation.text: "Etherium", section "Mining rights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret returns to Esper and murders the entire Seekers sect, sparing only Silas Renn, then makes the Sanctum his fortress.
timeline.quote: he murdered the entire sect, eliminating the new Hieresiarch and the whole Arcane Council.

citation.text: "Etherium", section "After the Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Breya becomes the first to create etherium from sangrite harvested from Jund, replacing most of her body with it.
timeline.quote: The young human artificer Breya was the first to create etherium from sangrite harvested from Jund.

citation.text: "Etherium", section "After the Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Bant castle emerges through the terrain, intruding on a sea of Esper.
timeline.quote: which shows Bant intruding on one of the seas of Esper

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bant barely touches black and red mana at the Conflux, yet Paragon of the Amesha uses it.
timeline.quote: At the time of the Conflux, Bant has barely come in contact with black mana (from Esper) and red mana (from Naya)

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Xorin and Sharuum learn from a scout that the spire Harborgate is lost, with twenty-seven missing and much etherium gone.
timeline.quote: Another spire's been lost. Harborgate.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sharuum refuses Xorin's call for an invasion and orders the armillaries consulted.
timeline.quote: Incorrect. First we consult the armillaries.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Travius, a Seeker, divines the location of Harborgate with an armillary sphere.
timeline.quote: Harborgate. It's there, past the Inkwell, past Esper's frontier.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Travius reveals each outlying tower is seeded with a Seeker, so the loss of Harborgate may serve the mission.
timeline.quote: Someone to ensure that disaster can be turned into opportunity.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Four days later Travius reports no word from Harborgate and Sharuum accepts the Seekers' way.
timeline.quote: No word from Harborgate.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column explains that the Conflux has so far physically overlapped only adjacent shards, so Esper's main conflicts are with Bant and Grixis.
timeline.quote: the main conflicts for Esper have been with Bant and Grixis

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Esper and Grixis crush together at their frontiers, with thousands dying.
timeline.quote: Thousands die at every frontier!

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The knight rides into Esper, where blue mana is strongest.
timeline.quote: The knight headed on, into Esper, where the call of blue mana was strongest

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Dragons besiege Antoris City, which sits on a volcano; the mage council works together and pools etherium.
timeline.quote: Dragons besieged Antoris City.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An etherium abomination is given life by the etherium of a hundred slain Esperites.
timeline.quote: It was given life by the etherium of a hundred slain Esperites.

citation.text: Etherium Abomination (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sharuum the Hegemon claims the soul is only as eternal as she says.
timeline.quote: The soul is only as eternal as I say it is.

citation.text: Mind Funeral (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients are found slain for four nights.
timeline.quote: For four nights following Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients were found slain, the etherium ripped from their bodies.

citation.text: Vedalken Ghoul (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret declares etherium limited but innovation not.
timeline.quote: Etherium is limited. Innovation is not.

citation.text: Thopter Foundry (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Alara was reborn, vedalken heretics from Esper reject etherium for nature in the jungles of Naya.
timeline.quote: they rejected the cold clutch of etherium in favor of the warm embrace of nature

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Nayan Vedalken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thunder Thrash raids Esper and attacks an etherium storehouse under Jkkhah.
timeline.quote: their elder Jkkhah led the thrash to attack a facility that turned out to be a temporary wartime storehouse for etherium

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Thunder Thrash emerges with illicit etherium enhancements and destroys the Esper strike force.
timeline.quote: the Thunder Thrash emerged, strange etherium enhancements suffusing their muscular frames

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Creative proposes the Esper telemins as a concept for Conflux, producing Telemin Performance.
timeline.quote: I told him a few, including the idea of the Esper telemins—"mage dolls" who volunteer to be mind-controlled by virtuoso mind-mages.

citation.text: "Flavor Driven". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret joins the Seekers of Carmot and learns they are run by Bolas.
timeline.quote: He learned that the Seekers are run by Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Test of Metal", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grixis falls under Bolas's sway while Esper ignores his influence until too late.
timeline.quote: Grixis was firmly under the sway of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Sculptor recalls crafting etherium bodies in Esper.
timeline.quote: He had crafted bodies from etherium in Esper before he realized his work had been a perverted lie.

citation.text: "The Stonekiller". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret flees to Esper and learns from Tibalt that Bolas is dead.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret fled to Esper on Alara

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret beats Ral in hand-to-hand combat and gives him his damaged arm as proof of the kill.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret showed mercy and gave Ral his damaged etherium arm to provide proof of the kill

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel to warn Rafiq as Phyrexians assault Alara.
timeline.quote: he tasked a street urchin named Estel to deliver a message to Rafiq

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Phyrexia: All Will be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alara is struck at Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

citation.text: "Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
timeline.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Esper's forces invade the other shards looking for carmot.
timeline.quote: The forces of Esper invade the other shards looking for carmot, an element necessary to create more of their dwindling etherium.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Esper mages devoted to the Noble Work.
relations.quote: the Ethersworn, the group of Esper mages who are devoted to the project of infusing all life on the plane with etherium

citation.text: "Time for Esper". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: The sphinx who rules the plane.
relations.quote: The sphinx who rules the whole place—we've called her Sharuum the Hegemon

citation.text: "Time for Esper". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: She is the hegemon whose audience needs an unheard riddle.
relations.quote: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

citation.text: Sharuum the Hegemon (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Described as a vedalken consul giving an Esper outlook.
relations.quote: The vedalken consul Cinna, a great speaker wherever she goes, gives us a particularly Esperesque outlook on how to go about building theories

citation.text: "Shards of Alara in Italics". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Perfection through Etherium". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Aim to infuse every living thing on Esper with etherium.
relations.quote: It's the goal of the council of mages known as the Ethersworn to infuse every living thing on Esper with etherium.

citation.work: The Needs of Cards and Beyond
citation.text: "The Needs of Cards and Beyond". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Bant intrudes on Esper's seas at the overlap
relations.quote: which shows Bant intruding on one of the seas of Esper

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: wise sphinx and the Hegemon of all of Esper

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

citation.work: The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas
citation.text: "The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: the forsaken underground where the Esper elite relegated the dregs

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

relations.quote: Under the foresight of Esper's ruling sphinxes , the plane has transformed from wilderness to a tightly-controlled magocracy.

citation.text: "Esper", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Faction + Fiction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: The shard of etherium, sphinxes, vedalken and mechanists, with twenty-three named winds.

citation.text: Shards of Alara: card flavor text (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.
